d:
Bihar ke katihar ke langra bagan sthit relve kvartar men rahne vale relve karmachari satish kumar yadav ke 16 sal ke bete shubham kumar ne apni pratibha se sabko prabhavit kiya hai. 11vin kaksha ke is chhatr ne bekar pare kabar ke saman se bijli aur pani bachane vale do anokhe divais taiyar kie hain. bina kisi mahange sansadhan ya bari prayogshala ke shubham ne apni jigyasa aur mehnat se yah kamal kar dikhaya hai
